changeinfo.changes:
• Fixed some issues with the text.
  • Upwardly adjusted the simultaneous fire rate and melee attack power of the M870 Shotguns and Yurina Custom.
  • Fixed an issue where it was possible for the buddy to blow herself up with an explosive weapon.
  • Fixed a bug where the trophy for acquiring all weapons failed to unlock for some players.
  • (If you have fulfilled the criteria, the trophy will unlock next time you go into the main menu.)
  • Fixed an issue where a redundant blank space would appear upon acquiring certain bonus content.
  • Fixed an issue where the game would freeze during Intensive Drilling when all items were items that could be used on the mouth and all items were in a reload state.
  • Fixed an issue where a character’s level would occasionally be wrongly displayed.
  • Fixed an issue where conversation events would fail to start when progressing through the story.
  • Made it so that stick control settings during Intensive Drilling reflect reverse control settings in Options.
  • Added a function to skip conversation events during battles.
  • Added a function on the main menu to display or hide the menu by pressing the △ button.
  • Fixed an issue where some enemies failed to spawn in “Mission 49: Gun of her Dreams” on Hard mode.
  • Fixed an issue where DLC item “Meika's Tactics Textbook” failed to be consumed.
